name: Dartford Foodbank
short_description: Part of The Trussell Trust network providing emergency food parcels. Based at Dartford Baptist Church. Open Tue and Fri for distribution. Referral required via local agencies.

description: Volunteer-run community garden within Central Park. Grows vegetables and soft fruits with harvest shared among volunteers. Open weekends during growing season.
